title: Takemitsu Zamurai
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: On New Year's morning the ronin Senou Souichirou arrives in an Edo tenement, unsettling neighbors who sense a violent past. He pawns his sword for a bamboo one, becomes the local teacher and befriends the boy Kankichi. When murders, including of sex workers, disturb the area and the assassin Kikuchi Shinnosuke targets him, his fascination with the sword resurfaces before he finds a fragile peace and quietly leaves.
life_message: Peace is chosen daily against one's own violent nature, and community can soften a hardened heart, if only for a time.

folkways.japan: The tenement (nagaya) community and the ronin's code reflect Edo-period jidaimono conventions, as critic Natsume Fusanosuke notes.

delivery.evidence: Wikipedia: critic reads it as jidaimono; quiet slice-of-life tone (AniList, MU genres); no lessons stated.

delivery.note: The assassin is driven by bloodlust yet shown tender toward animals, so the story avoids a flat villain.

winners_losers: Souichirou survives and leaves in peace; the story sympathizes with the tenement community and with his struggle against himself.
